name: H3 reference picture noise setting
plain: Exposes core's visual-condition noise value, which sets how noisy reference pictures and pinned frames look to the model and the time label they carry. Lower means a tighter hold, and higher gives the prompt and LoRAs more say, according to the node's message.
math:
a = 1 − ref_noise; sets minimax_visual_cond_noise_aug = a.
Reported as picture' = a·picture + ref_noise·noise, shown at t ≥ a. Core default ref_noise 0.001.
